title: Help me decide on the perspective of my farming game
author: MrJurasek
selftext:
Hey there!  
Over the last few weeks I managed to transfer my browser game Loopy Farm - Farming idle tycoon from "old 2D top down" to 3D.

Moving the game from 2D to 3D brought me a new perspective on my project (pun intended). The game now allows players to switch perspectives , which is a good option to have, but I can't decide what should be the default.

Having these 3 options at once opens up a nice place to experiment live on the project, but that will require a large sample size first.

So the question is simple. Out of these 3 specific cameras, is there a one that you prefer over the other ones?

If yes, what are the reasons behind that? I'm interested in hearing your opinions!

BTW - The game is already live on Google Play. Currently only available at SK, CZ, POL, PHI. But new markets and iOS are coming soon.

So if you are interested in trying this game, you can already check the game at [https://loopyfarm.com/mobile](https://loopyfarm.com/mobile/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=community&utm_campaign=r_vibecoding) and leave me an email, so you don't miss when the games is live global.

See you at the farm 🚜

Notes: Made in Godot + Claude Code Opus 5.5
